description: Amazon CloudWatch alarm (OK -> ALARM) delivered through SNS to Amazon Q Developer in chat applications (formerly AWS Chatbot), with the alarm's NewStateReason and metric details.
provenance: Amazon Q Developer in chat applications admin guide (CloudWatch alarms reach chat through an SNS topic mapped to the channel configuration; the notification shows 'CloudWatch Alarm | <alarm name> | <region> | Account: <account id>', the state reason, metric details, a graph and console links). The reason text is CloudWatch's standard NewStateReason: 'Threshold Crossed: N out of the last M datapoints [<value> (<dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss>)] was greater than or equal to the threshold (<t>) (minimum 1 datapoint for OK -> ALARM transition).'

attachments.title: :rotating_light: CloudWatch Alarm | checkout-5xx-high | us-east-1 | Account: 123456789012
attachments.text:
Target 5xx responses on the checkout load balancer are above 25 per minute.

Threshold Crossed: 1 out of the last 1 datapoints [57.0 (20/10/26 14:01:00)] was greater than or equal to the threshold (25.0) (minimum 1 datapoint for OK -> ALARM transition).
